title: Desertial!
description: This mod adds some plants to the desert, along with a few extra things.
body:
## Welcome to Desertial!
[image will be added later when made]

{Version 0.0.2 is the most recent version}

This mod adds a few new plants to the desert to breath more life into it, making it so the deserts are not so barren anymore!

This is but one of the expansion mods!

[Disclaimer: There's very little in this mod as of now]

#### Things to know about this mod
This mod can probably be used on Servers due to its currently simple nature.

## Additions in this mod:

### Items
#### Basic Items
- Resin Relic - {currently unobtainable}

#### Consumables
{No Consumables as of now}

### Blocks
- Silky Sand
- Smooth Soil
- Rough Soil

### Foliage
- Bulb Cactus
- Dry Tufflesprout
- Oasibloom Blossom
- Pricklespine Bush
- Pillarspine Cactus
- Thistleweed
- Tufflesprout
- Sparse Grass

### Crops
- {No Crops as of now}

### Workstations
{No Workstations as of now}

This mod is all about expanding the world, one of many additions, each update will add some kind of new plant, item or feature, bug-fixes will be done on this in time and there are some Advancements to get in this mod.

[Note: This mod is currently under development and some things may be added, changed or altered]
